surface_name: API Gateway REST API Lambda proxy integration
title: API Gateway REST API returns 502 Bad Gateway with Malformed Lambda proxy response though the Lambda succeeded
symptoms: Execution log: Execution failed due to configuration error: Malformed Lambda proxy response
Lambda returns a plain object or a body that is an object
cause: A REST API proxy integration only accepts a response object with statusCode, optional headers, and body as a string. Any other shape, including an object body, becomes a 502.
fix: Return statusCode and a JSON string body from the handler, and add CORS headers there because proxy integrations do not add them.
affected: REST APIs (v1) with Lambda proxy integration (type AWS_PROXY), whose response shape is fixed; HTTP APIs only when the integration uses payload format version 1.0, since 2.0 infers a response from plain JSON
